tier_reason: First-party README Showcase (added 2021-09-14) gives benchstat deltas on a named CPU (i9-8950HK) from public benchmark code (ascii/ascii_test.go BenchmarkEqualFoldString, bswap/swap64_test.go BenchmarkSwap64, qsort/sort_test.go BenchmarkSort16) run via the Makefile benchcmp target, but the Go toolchain version is not stated, so it falls short of A; no independent measurement found.

corrections.baseline: the package's own pure-Go fallback implementations of the same functions, selected with the purego build tag (Makefile benchcmp target runs go test -bench with -tags purego as 'old' and without it as 'new'); for ascii a table-lookup unrolled EqualFoldString, for bswap an encoding/binary loop, for qsort the package's Go quicksort128 with Hoare partition. Not Go stdlib functions (strings.EqualFold, sort.Slice); no stdlib numbers are published.
corrections.compiler_and_flags: go test -run _ -count 5 -bench, once with -tags purego and once without, compared with benchstat (Makefile benchcmp target; p=0.008 n=5+5). Go version not stated (showcase committed 2021-09-14; go.mod now says go 1.18).
corrections.caveats: Three hand-picked first-party snapshots from 2021 on one laptop CPU (i9-8950HK, darwin/amd64); Go version not stated. The baseline is the project's own pure-Go fallback (purego tag), not the Go standard library; a BenchmarkStdlibSort8 (sort.Slice) exists in qsort/sort_test.go but its numbers are not published. The qsort win mixes SIMD with a different algorithm (hybrid Lomuto/Hoare partition from the reverberate.org blog) that the purego path does not use; qsort assembly is amd64-only. ascii.EqualFold is ASCII-only and not semantically equal to strings.EqualFold. Harness defects outside the showcase: BenchmarkSort32 calls benchSort(count, 0, 32, ...) so element size is 0 and Sort returns immediately (measures nothing), and the 'partially-ordered' Sort8 sub-benchmarks pass order=random so the partial-ordering setup never runs. Go assembly library, not callable from C++. Last commit 2023-11-07 is a licence change (MIT to MIT-0); code last changed 2022-05. MIT-0 gives no explicit patent grant.

notes: README numbers match the record exactly (EqualFoldString/0512 276 ns to 21 ns, Swap64 11.2 us to 0.9 us, Sort16/1000000 269 ms to 46 ms). 'old' is the purego build of the same package (baseline is a scalar Go reference, fits the category's scalar-reference baseline). Metadata confirmed on github.com: MIT-0, 928 stars, not archived or a fork, last commit 2023-11-07 (stale). Shortcomings to record: own-fallback baseline only, Go version unstated, degenerate BenchmarkSort32 and never-run partially-ordered setup in qsort benchmarks, Go-only (not C++).
